sources.accessBasis: Public-page metadata collection restored at user request. Reuse permission remains unverified. No descriptions or images retained.
sources.coverage: Public ASLA opportunity listings; deadlines and eligibility require organizer review.

sources.name: Landezine
sources.accessBasis: Metadata-only public listing-page collection restored at user request. Current robots permits this page; disallowed RSS paths are not requested. Reuse permission remains unverified.
sources.coverage: Public Calls & Opportunities listing page; article publication dates are not deadlines. No descriptions or images retained.

sources.name: Young Architects Competitions (YAC)
sources.accessBasis: Public listing and terms reviewed. No explicit automated-access prohibition found in published participation terms; no blanket reuse license inferred. Titles, links and factual metadata only; runtime robots checks enforced.
sources.coverage: Official open-competitions index, plus submission-calendar checks for up to 10 briefs per run. Registration dates and results dates are not submission deadlines; eligibility remains unverified.

sources.name: Archinect
sources.accessBasis: Official Atom feed; Archinect Terms of Use expressly exempt RSS access from the automated-access restriction. Metadata only; no article or directory scraping.
sources.coverage: Conservatively filtered individual competition announcements from the latest 30 general-feed entries. Excludes results, shortlists and multi-competition roundups. Limited discovery, not a complete directory; deadlines and participation remain unverified.

sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.accessBasis: Browser-rendered public listing collection enabled at user request. Published terms require written scraping permission; publisher permission remains unresolved. Runtime robots checks enforced; no sign-in, proxies or challenge-solving.
sources.coverage: One rendered competition index page per run; duplicate cards and result announcements excluded. Titles and links only, without descriptions/images. No detail-page crawl, pagination, inferred deadlines or open/eligibility claims.
